about_the_game:
You wake up locked in a dark, quiet house and something is hunting you.

You don’t know how you got here. The doors are locked, the windows are boarded up, and blood is smeared on the floor. Somewhere in the house, a strange puppet moves through the shadows… and it’s looking for you.

To escape, you’ll need to search every room, find clues, solve puzzles, and unlock the front door while staying out of the Evil Doll’s sight. If it finds you, it won’t let you go.

A HOUSE FULL OF MYSTERIES

This isn’t just an old house. Something terrible happened here.

Each puzzle you solve brings you a step closer to freedom and closer to the truth behind the Evil Doll and what it’s guarding.

RUN. HIDE. STAY QUIET.

The Evil Doll hears everything. Drop something? It will come.

Turn on the lights? He will turn it off for you.

You’ll have to move quietly, find safe hiding spots, and use your head to stay alive.

FIND TOOLS, UNLOCK DOORS, STAY ALIVE

You’ll need more than just courage to escape.

Look for keys, a hammer, and other tools to open doors, break planks and unlock new areas.

Some tools may help you slow down the Evil Doll… but only for a short amount of time.

CAN YOU ESCAPE?

Find clues, pick your path, and figure out how to open the locked front door, before it’s too late.

FEATURES

  • A creepy, detailed house to explore

  • Scary hide-and-seek gameplay with smart enemy AI

  • Tools and weapons that help you survive

  • Puzzles, keys, and secret paths

  • A dark story with hidden notes and clues

DON’T LET IT FIND YOU

You’re trapped, alone, and being watched.

Solve the puzzles, find the truth, and escape the house—before the Evil Doll catches you.
